legal.disclaimer.title: PullMC Open-Source Notice
legal.disclaimer.lead: Before your first use, please read and confirm the following.
legal.disclaimer.body: PullMC is an open-source, unofficial downloader and deployer for Minecraft: Java Edition. It only provides version metadata retrieval, file downloads, and local verification.
legal.disclaimer.item1: This project does not host or operate any game resource site and does not mirror game files. Download requests are sent directly from your device to the source you choose (Mojang's official servers, public mirrors such as BMCLAPI, or loader vendors' official sources) and do not pass through this project's servers.
legal.disclaimer.item2: This project is not affiliated with, partnered with, authorized by, or endorsed by Microsoft, Mojang Studios, their affiliates, or their agents.
legal.disclaimer.item3: Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. This project's name is used only to describe compatibility and does not imply endorsement by Mojang Studios.
legal.disclaimer.item4: Before use, please confirm that you have legally obtained a license for Minecraft: Java Edition through official channels and that you comply with its End User License Agreement.
legal.disclaimer.item5: This project is provided "as is" and does not guarantee the availability, stability, or security of third-party download sources; you assume the risks of use.
legal.disclaimer.accept: I have read and understood the notice above
legal.disclaimer.save_error: Could not save your confirmation. Check disk permissions and try again.
